scope: Agent-driven local-model reviews and direct-source adjudication; this is not real-human evidence.

findingsReviewed.finding: Main archive-index writers appeared to use different lock sidecars.
findingsReviewed.disposition: not confirmed after reading electron/utils/atomic-write.ts and openclaw_runtime/src/infra/file-lock.ts; both resolve the same .clawx-write.lock sidecar and writes re-read inside the lock.

findingsReviewed.finding: Lifecycle refusals might be emitted as successful RPC payloads.
findingsReviewed.disposition: corrected; refusals use the RPC error channel, ErrorShape.details, and a handler-level test exercises the actual response shape.

findingsReviewed.finding: Archive retry digest included mutable renderer metadata.
findingsReviewed.disposition: corrected; retry identity is kind + SessionKey and the first journaled manifest preserves original metadata.

findingsReviewed.finding: Aliased keys could mismatch committed receipts.
findingsReviewed.disposition: corrected; handler-level tests verify the requested key is echoed while the runtime canonical key remains internal.

findingsReviewed.finding: Malformed archive paths could escape as unstructured errors.
findingsReviewed.disposition: corrected; new index and journal paths are contained before mutation and return structured definitive refusals.

findingsReviewed.finding: Definitive conflicts could leak archive leases or restore fences.
findingsReviewed.disposition: corrected; definitive conflicts settle or release fences and caches, while unknown results retain them for exact-operation recovery.

findingsReviewed.finding: A missing archived transcript might be permanent and wedge the operation.
findingsReviewed.disposition: intentionally treated as unknown/retryable; the source can reappear after a crash window, and A2 requires unknown outcomes not to unlock. Recovery remains the same operationId and fence.

findingsReviewed.finding: Async updateSessionStore mutation and lock contracts were absent from review.
findingsReviewed.disposition: verified against the included store/file-lock owner code and covered by runtime and E2E gates.
resolved by populating cleanup-readback.json from the clean-candidate Playwright process ledger and run-root sweep.

findingsReviewed.finding: The duplicate live+archived transcript row appeared passed without a named assertion.
findingsReviewed.disposition: corrected; a deterministic restore-intent test now proves definitive conflict and new-generation fence release.

findingsReviewed.finding: Curated lint and credential gates referenced scripts only under D:/tmp.
findingsReviewed.disposition: corrected; lint-scoped.mjs and credential-scan.mjs are copied into evidence; credential scan records its exact file list and pattern names.

findingsReviewed.finding: README scan count and platform skip were not self-describing.
findingsReviewed.disposition: README is regenerated from final receipts and root-test-notes.json records the Windows/POSIX permission skip.

overall: No unresolved P1/P2 issue remains after direct-source adjudication; one P1 review hypothesis conflicts with the explicit A2 unknown-outcome contract and is retained as a documented limitation.
